companies.name: Atul

parts.SELLS: Atul makes a wide range of chemicals from a huge integrated site in south Gujarat: crop-protection chemicals such as herbicides, aromatics like para-cresol used in fragrances and medicines, epoxy resins and adhesives sold under the Lapox brand, dyes and pharma intermediates. Its buyers are other manufacturers in India and abroad.
parts.EARNS: It reports two segments: Life Science Chemicals, covering crop protection and pharma ingredients, and Performance and Other Chemicals, covering aromatics, polymers and colours. Performance chemicals bring in the larger share of sales, and exports to the US, Europe and Asia make up a big part of revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of India's oldest and most diversified chemical makers, founded in 1947 by the Lalbhai family. Its Gujarat site is among the largest single chemical complexes in the country.
parts.RIVALS: Aarti Industries, Vinati Organics, Deepak Nitrite and SRF in specialty chemicals, UPL in crop protection, and low-cost Chinese producers in many of its products.
parts.WATCH: New plants at its Gujarat site, including chlor-alkali and other upstream units it has announced, pricing pressure from Chinese suppliers, and demand from global agrochemical and fragrance customers.

quiz.prompt: Under which brand does Atul sell epoxy resins and adhesives?
Which Atul segment brings in the larger share of sales?
Which of these is a rival to Atul in specialty chemicals?

companies.note_30w: Atul is a diversified Gujarat chemical maker selling crop-protection chemicals, aromatics, epoxy resins and dyes to manufacturers worldwide. Watch Chinese competition and its new upstream plants.

companies.name: Authum Investment & Infrastructure

parts.SELLS: Authum is a non-bank finance company that holds a large portfolio of listed shares, unlisted stakes and real-estate assets, and also lends to businesses and individuals. It grew fast after taking over Reliance Commercial Finance through an insolvency process, which brought in a sizeable loan book.
parts.EARNS: Most of its income comes from gains and dividends on the shares and stakes it holds, so profits swing with financial markets. Interest earned on loans, including the book it took over from Reliance Commercial Finance, is the second engine.
parts.SIZE: One of the larger listed proprietary-portfolio NBFCs in India, controlled by the Dangi family. It entered the broader market indices only in recent years after very rapid growth.
parts.RIVALS: Other diversified finance groups such as JM Financial, IIFL Finance and Edelweiss, and holding-style NBFCs that earn mainly from their portfolios of listed shares.
parts.WATCH: How it builds out lending from the Reliance Commercial Finance book, how much of its profit keeps coming from market gains, and any further acquisitions of stressed finance companies it announces.

quiz.prompt: Which company did Authum take over through an insolvency process?
Where does most of Authum's income come from?
options: Gains and dividends on shares it holds

quiz.prompt: Which company does Authum compete with?

companies.note_30w: Authum is a Mumbai NBFC that earns mostly from a large portfolio of shares and stakes, plus lending from its Reliance Commercial Finance takeover. Profits swing with markets.

companies.name: Avanti Feeds

parts.SELLS: Avanti Feeds makes feed for shrimp and fish farmers, mostly in Andhra Pradesh, and also processes and exports frozen shrimp through its subsidiary Avanti Frozen Foods. Thailand's Thai Union is its long-standing technology partner and shareholder.
parts.EARNS: Shrimp feed sold to aquaculture farmers is the largest business and the main profit driver. The processed-shrimp arm earns from exports, with the US and other overseas buyers taking most of its output.
parts.SIZE: India's largest shrimp-feed maker by most industry estimates and one of the country's bigger shrimp exporters, with feed mills and processing plants concentrated in coastal Andhra Pradesh.
parts.RIVALS: CP Aquaculture (part of Thailand's Charoen Pokphand), Growel Feeds, The Waterbase and other feed makers, plus Ecuadorian and Indonesian shrimp exporters in global markets.
parts.WATCH: Steep US tariffs on Indian goods that hit shrimp exports from 2025, how farmers in Andhra Pradesh respond to price swings, and its push into new markets and products beyond shrimp feed.

quiz.prompt: What is Avanti Feeds' largest business?
Which Thai company is Avanti's long-standing partner?
Which of these competes with Avanti in shrimp feed?

companies.note_30w: Avanti Feeds is India's largest shrimp-feed maker and also exports frozen shrimp, partnered with Thai Union. Watch US tariffs on Indian shrimp and Andhra farm demand.

companies.name: Azad Engineering

parts.SELLS: Azad Engineering makes precision-machined parts such as turbine blades and airfoils for power-plant turbines, jet engines, defence and oil-and-gas equipment. Its customers are global engine and turbine makers like GE Vernova, Siemens Energy, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Rolls-Royce and Honeywell. It listed in December 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying critical rotating parts under long-term contracts with global manufacturers. Energy turbine parts bring in most revenue, with aerospace and defence growing, and the bulk of sales are exports.
parts.SIZE: One of a handful of Indian firms qualified to make critical turbine and aero-engine components for global majors. Still a mid-sized company, but growing quickly.
parts.RIVALS: PTC Industries and MTAR Technologies in India, and global precision-parts makers such as Precision Castparts and Doncasters, as well as the in-house parts units of big engine makers.
parts.WATCH: New manufacturing capacity it is building near Hyderabad, long-term supply deals it has signed with Rolls-Royce and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, and demand from gas-turbine makers.

quiz.prompt: What does Azad Engineering mainly make?
Where does most of Azad's revenue come from?
options: Exports to global turbine and engine makers

quiz.prompt: Which Indian company is a rival to Azad?

companies.note_30w: Azad Engineering makes turbine blades and precision aero-engine parts for global giants like GE Vernova and Rolls-Royce. Mostly exports. Watch new Hyderabad capacity and long-term contracts.

companies.name: BEML

parts.SELLS: BEML, a defence-ministry PSU, makes heavy machines in three verticals: mining and construction equipment such as dozers, dump trucks and rope shovels; rail and metro coaches, including Vande Bharat sleeper trainsets; and defence vehicles like Tatra-based trucks and the Arjun armoured recovery vehicle.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling equipment and coaches to Coal India, metro corporations, Indian Railways and the armed forces, mostly through tenders. Mining and construction plus rail and metro are its biggest revenue sources.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest makers of earth-moving equipment and metro coaches, and a key supplier to the Indian Army. The government owns a majority stake, and it runs plants in Karnataka and Kerala.
parts.RIVALS: Caterpillar, Komatsu and Tata Hitachi in mining equipment; Alstom, Titagarh Rail Systems and Medha in rail and metro; Ashok Leyland and Tata Advanced Systems in defence vehicles.
parts.WATCH: Delivery of Vande Bharat sleeper trains, a new plant it has announced in Chhattisgarh, metro coach orders, and defence export efforts it showcased at Land Forces 2026 in Australia.

quiz.prompt: Which train does BEML build for Indian Railways?
Who mainly buys BEML's products?
options: Coal India, metro corporations, railways and the army

quiz.prompt: Which company competes with BEML in mining equipment?

companies.note_30w: BEML is a defence-ministry PSU making mining machines, metro and Vande Bharat coaches and army vehicles. Watch sleeper-train deliveries, a new Chhattisgarh plant and metro orders.

companies.name: BLS International

parts.SELLS: BLS International handles visa, passport and consular services for foreign governments, running application centres where travellers submit documents and biometrics. It also runs citizen-service centres for Indian states and, through BLS E-Services, banking correspondent outlets. It bought Turkey's iDATA to grow its visa business.
parts.EARNS: Visa and consular services are the largest and most profitable business: governments outsource processing and BLS earns a service fee on each application plus optional extras like courier and premium lounges. Digital and citizen services earn smaller margins.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest visa-outsourcing firms, second only to VFS Global in many markets, with application centres spread across dozens of countries on several continents.
parts.RIVALS: VFS Global and TLScontact in visa outsourcing for governments; CSC e-Governance Services and other operators in citizen services and banking correspondent outlets across India.
parts.WATCH: India's foreign ministry barred it in 2025 from bidding on new ministry tenders for a period, so watch how that plays out; also contract renewals with European governments and integration of iDATA.

quiz.prompt: What is BLS International's main business?
options: Visa and consular services for governments

quiz.prompt: Who is BLS International's biggest global rival?
Which Turkish visa firm did BLS buy?

companies.note_30w: BLS International runs visa and consular centres for foreign governments, earning a fee per application. Watch the Indian foreign-ministry tender ban, European contracts and its iDATA purchase.

companies.name: Bagmane Prime Office REIT

parts.SELLS: Bagmane Prime Office REIT owns large Grade A office parks in Bengaluru, such as Bagmane Tech Park, Bagmane Constellation and Bagmane World Technology Center. Its tenants are mostly global technology firms and global capability centres. It is a recently listed REIT backed by Blackstone and the Bagmane Group.
parts.EARNS: It earns rent from office tenants on multi-year leases, plus fees for parking and maintenance. As a REIT it must pay out most of its cash to unitholders as distributions. Leasing to multinational tech tenants drives almost all of its income.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger office REITs and among the biggest office landlords in Bengaluru, which is the country's main market for technology offices and global capability centres.
parts.RIVALS: Embassy Office Parks REIT, Mindspace Business Parks REIT, Knowledge Realty Trust and Brookfield India REIT, plus private landlords such as RMZ and Prestige.
parts.WATCH: Demand for Bengaluru offices from global capability centres, filling vacant space, new blocks it is developing within its parks, and how its sponsors manage their remaining stakes.

quiz.prompt: Where are Bagmane REIT's office parks located?
How does a REIT like Bagmane mainly earn money?
Which global firm backs Bagmane REIT alongside the Bagmane Group?

companies.note_30w: Bagmane Prime Office REIT owns Grade A Bengaluru office parks leased to global tech firms and capability centres. Backed by Blackstone. Watch leasing demand and new blocks.

companies.name: Balkrishna Industries (BKT)

parts.SELLS: Balkrishna Industries makes off-highway tyres under the BKT brand: tyres for tractors and farm machines, construction and mining equipment, industrial vehicles and ATVs. Most of its customers are farm-equipment makers and replacement buyers in Europe and the Americas. The BKT name is well known from sports sponsorships.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling specialty tyres, mostly in the replacement market, where margins are better than selling to vehicle makers. Agricultural tyres are the largest category, and Europe is its biggest region, followed by the Americas and India.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's leading off-highway tyre makers and India's largest exporter of such tyres, with large plants in Rajasthan, Gujarat and Maharashtra serving buyers worldwide.
parts.RIVALS: Michelin, Yokohama Off-Highway Tires (which owns the Alliance and Galaxy brands), Bridgestone, and Indian players like Apollo Tyres and CEAT in farm tyres.
parts.WATCH: Its push to sell more in India and the US, its carbon black and new capacity projects, US tariffs on Indian exports, and farm-machinery demand in Europe.

quiz.prompt: What kind of tyres does BKT mainly make?
options: Off-highway tyres for farm and mining machines

quiz.prompt: Which region is Balkrishna's biggest market?
Which company is a global rival of BKT?

companies.note_30w: Balkrishna Industries sells BKT off-highway tyres for tractors, mining and construction machines, mostly to Europe and the Americas. Watch US tariffs, India push and new capacity.

companies.name: Balrampur Chini Mills

parts.SELLS: Balrampur Chini runs sugar mills across eastern Uttar Pradesh. It crushes sugarcane into sugar, turns molasses and cane juice into ethanol for blending into petrol, and burns cane waste to generate power. It is building India's first industrial plant for PLA, a plant-based bioplastic.
parts.EARNS: Sugar sales bring in most revenue, while ethanol sold to oil marketing companies under the government's blending programme adds steady, higher-margin income. Cane prices and sugar export rules are set by government, which shapes profits.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest integrated sugar companies, with one of the biggest cane-crushing capacities in Uttar Pradesh, the country's top sugarcane-growing state.
parts.RIVALS: Triveni Engineering, EID Parry, Dalmia Bharat Sugar, Dhampur Sugar Mills and Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar, plus other ethanol producers selling to oil marketing companies.
parts.WATCH: Commissioning of its PLA bioplastics plant at Kumbhi in Uttar Pradesh, ethanol procurement prices, sugar export quotas and the state-set cane price each season.

quiz.prompt: What new product is Balrampur Chini building a plant for?
Who buys Balrampur's ethanol?
options: Oil marketing companies for petrol blending

quiz.prompt: Which company is a rival to Balrampur Chini?

companies.note_30w: Balrampur Chini runs Uttar Pradesh sugar mills, earning from sugar, ethanol and power. Watch its first-of-its-kind PLA bioplastics plant, ethanol prices and sugar export rules.

companies.name: Bandhan Bank

parts.SELLS: Bandhan Bank began as a microfinance lender to poor women in West Bengal and became a universal bank in 2015. It offers savings accounts, microloans to women's groups, home loans through the former Gruh Finance, and loans to small businesses, with most branches in east and north-east India.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors. Unsecured microloans to women borrowers have been its largest and highest-yielding book, though the bank is shifting towards secured loans like housing and business lending.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger private banks by branch reach in the east, and the biggest Indian bank born out of microfinance, with a dense network of branches and banking units in rural areas.
parts.RIVALS: Microlenders such as CreditAccess Grameen and Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, and banks like IndusInd Bank, Federal Bank and State Bank of India in its home states of the east.
parts.WATCH: Its move away from unsecured microloans, stress among microfinance borrowers, the strategy under MD Partha Pratim Sengupta, and former regulator Debasish Panda's arrival as chairman in July 2026.

quiz.prompt: How did Bandhan Bank start?
options: As a microfinance lender to women

quiz.prompt: Which loan book has been Bandhan's largest?
Who became Bandhan Bank's chairman in July 2026?

companies.note_30w: Bandhan Bank grew from microfinance into a universal bank strong in eastern India. Watch its shift to secured loans, microfinance stress and new chairman Debasish Panda.

companies.name: Bank of India

parts.SELLS: Bank of India is a government-owned bank founded in 1906 that offers savings accounts, home and car loans, farm and small-business loans, and large corporate loans. It is known for a strong overseas network in places like London, Singapore and the Gulf, and has a big rural presence in Maharashtra, Jharkhand and other states.
parts.EARNS: Interest earned on loans minus interest paid to depositors is its main income. Retail, agriculture and MSME loans, called RAM loans, are its fastest-growing book, while corporate lending remains large. Fees and treasury gains add the rest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger public-sector banks by deposits and loans, and among the PSU banks with the widest international presence, with branches and subsidiaries across several continents.
parts.RIVALS: Bank of Baroda, Canara Bank, Union Bank of India and Punjab National Bank among state-owned lenders, plus SBI and large private banks such as HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank in retail lending.
parts.WATCH: MD Rajneesh Karnatak's term was extended by three years from April 2026, so watch his plans for growing retail loans, keeping bad loans low and any government stake sales.

quiz.prompt: What is Bank of India known for compared to many PSU banks?
What do RAM loans stand for at Bank of India?
Which bank is a direct PSU rival to Bank of India?

companies.note_30w: Bank of India is a government-owned bank with a strong overseas network and growing retail, farm and MSME lending. Watch Rajneesh Karnatak's extended term and asset quality.

companies.name: Bank of Maharashtra

parts.SELLS: Bank of Maharashtra is a government-owned bank founded in 1935, with most of its branches in Maharashtra. It offers savings and current accounts, home, car and gold loans, loans to farmers and small businesses, and corporate lending.
parts.EARNS: Its main income is the gap between interest on loans and interest paid on deposits. It has an unusually large share of low-cost current and savings deposits, which keeps funding cheap, and it has become one of the most profitable PSU banks relative to its size.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized public-sector bank, smaller than SBI or Bank of Baroda, but among the fastest-growing and most profitable state-owned banks in recent years, with a deep network across Maharashtra.
parts.RIVALS: Central Bank of India, UCO Bank, Indian Overseas Bank and Punjab & Sind Bank among state-owned lenders, plus private banks in Maharashtra such as HDFC Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank.
parts.WATCH: The government has been cutting its stake to meet minimum public-shareholding rules, so watch further share sales; also MD Nidhu Saxena's plans to keep loan growth high and bad loans low.

quiz.prompt: In which state are most of Bank of Maharashtra's branches?
What keeps Bank of Maharashtra's funding cheap?
options: Large share of low-cost current and savings deposits

quiz.prompt: Why is the government cutting its stake in the bank?

companies.note_30w: Bank of Maharashtra is a Pune-based government bank with cheap deposits and strong profitability among PSU banks. Watch government stake sales and loan growth under Nidhu Saxena.

companies.name: Bata India

parts.SELLS: Bata India sells footwear through its own stores, franchise stores, multi-brand outlets and online. Brands include Bata, Bata Comfit, Hush Puppies, North Star, Power for sports shoes, and Floatz. It is part of the global Bata group, headquartered in Switzerland.
parts.EARNS: It earns by selling shoes, sandals and bags, mostly through its own and franchise stores. Its own retail stores bring in most revenue, while franchising in smaller towns and online sales are growing.
parts.SIZE: India's largest footwear retailer by store network and one of the most recognised shoe brands in the country, present in big cities as well as many small towns through franchise outlets.
parts.RIVALS: Metro Brands, Relaxo Footwears, Campus Activewear, Liberty Shoes and Khadim's in Indian footwear, plus global sports brands such as Nike, Adidas and Puma in sneakers and sports shoes.
parts.WATCH: Sanjay S. Rao, formerly of Nike and Inditex, took over as MD & CEO from Gunjan Shah in October 2026. Watch his plans for sneakers, store refreshes and franchise expansion.

quiz.prompt: Which of these is a Bata India brand?
Who became Bata India's MD & CEO in October 2026?
Which company is a rival to Bata in footwear?

companies.note_30w: Bata India is the country's largest footwear retailer, with brands like Bata, Hush Puppies and Power. Watch new MD Sanjay S. Rao's plans for sneakers and franchising.

companies.name: Belrise Industries

parts.SELLS: Belrise Industries, formerly Badve Engineering, makes sheet-metal and casting parts, chassis systems, exhaust systems and polymer components for two-wheelers, cars and commercial vehicles. Its customers include Bajaj Auto, Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India, Hero MotoCorp and Jaguar Land Rover. It listed in May 2025.
parts.EARNS: It earns by supplying parts to vehicle makers under long-running contracts. Two-wheeler components bring in most revenue, with four-wheeler and commercial-vehicle parts growing as it diversifies.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger two-wheeler sheet-metal component makers, with many plants across Maharashtra and other states, and a founder-led company that has grown quickly since listing.
parts.RIVALS: Uno Minda, Endurance Technologies, JBM Auto, Lumax Industries and other auto-component makers that supply metal and plastic parts to two-wheeler and car makers in India.
parts.WATCH: Use of money it raised through a QIP in July 2026, diversification into cars and commercial vehicles, new plants it has announced, and two-wheeler demand in India.

quiz.prompt: What was Belrise Industries formerly called?
Which vehicle segment brings Belrise most revenue?
Which company competes with Belrise?

companies.note_30w: Belrise Industries makes sheet-metal, chassis and polymer parts mainly for two-wheeler makers like Bajaj and Honda. Recently listed. Watch diversification into cars and new plants.

companies.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals (BHEL)

parts.SELLS: BHEL is a government-owned engineering company that builds equipment for power plants: boilers, steam turbines and generators for coal, gas, hydro and nuclear plants. It also makes transmission equipment, railway locomotives and Vande Bharat sleeper trains with Titagarh, defence products and industrial machinery.
parts.EARNS: Its largest business by far is power: designing, supplying and building thermal power plants for NTPC, state utilities and private firms. Industry segments like rail, transmission and defence add the rest.
parts.SIZE: India's largest power-equipment maker, which has built most of the country's coal-fired generating capacity, with large factories in Haridwar, Bhopal, Tiruchirappalli and Hyderabad.
parts.RIVALS: Larsen & Toubro in power projects, Siemens Energy, GE Vernova and Doosan in turbines and generators, and Chinese equipment makers such as Harbin Electric and Dongfang Electric in global bids.
parts.WATCH: Execution of a big wave of new thermal power orders, delivery of Vande Bharat sleeper trains, and the selection of a new CMD as K. Sadashiv Murthy is due to retire in February 2027.

quiz.prompt: What is BHEL's largest business?
Which company is BHEL's main Indian rival in power projects?
Which train is BHEL building with Titagarh?

companies.note_30w: BHEL is India's largest power-equipment maker, building boilers and turbines for thermal plants. Watch execution of new coal-plant orders and the search for its next CMD.

companies.name: Birlasoft

parts.SELLS: Birlasoft is a mid-sized IT services company in the CK Birla Group. It implements and runs enterprise software such as Oracle, SAP and Microsoft systems, and offers cloud, data and digital services. Its clients are mostly manufacturers, life-sciences firms, banks and energy companies.
parts.EARNS: It earns fees from multi-year contracts to build, run and upgrade clients' business software. North America brings in most of its revenue, and enterprise-software implementation, especially Oracle and SAP work, is its largest service line.
parts.SIZE: A mid-tier Indian IT services firm, much smaller than Infosys or HCLTech, but with deep expertise in enterprise resource planning software and a long list of large manufacturing clients.
parts.RIVALS: Mphasis, Zensar Technologies, Sonata Software, Hexaware and Coforge among mid-tier firms, plus the ERP practices of larger companies such as Infosys, Accenture and Deloitte.
parts.WATCH: Whether revenue growth picks up after a weak patch, the leadership reshuffle that brought in COO Vikram Puranik in April 2026, and how clients shift spending to AI-driven work.

quiz.prompt: Which business group does Birlasoft belong to?
Which region gives Birlasoft most of its revenue?
Which company is a mid-tier rival of Birlasoft?

companies.note_30w: Birlasoft is a CK Birla Group IT services firm specialising in Oracle, SAP and digital work, mostly for North American clients. Watch growth revival and AI-led demand.

companies.name: Black Box

parts.SELLS: Black Box, formerly AGC Networks, designs, builds and maintains digital infrastructure: data-centre cabling, enterprise networks, unified communications, cybersecurity and managed IT services. Its clients include large enterprises, hyperscale cloud firms and banks, mostly in the US and Europe. It is part of the Essar group.
parts.EARNS: It earns from projects to build networks and data-centre infrastructure, plus recurring support and managed-service contracts. North America brings in most of its revenue, and data-centre work for hyperscalers is a key growth area.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized global IT infrastructure firm with operations across many countries, built largely through the acquisition of US-based Black Box Corporation in 2019.
parts.RIVALS: NTT DATA, Kyndryl and the infrastructure arms of Wipro and Tech Mahindra, plus specialist cabling and network integrators in the US that build data-centre and campus networks.
parts.WATCH: Growth from hyperscaler data-centre projects, its push to improve margins after a restructuring, and new leadership hires to grow international markets.

quiz.prompt: What was Black Box formerly called in India?
Which region gives Black Box most of its revenue?
Which company competes with Black Box?

companies.note_30w: Black Box builds and manages networks, data-centre infrastructure and cybersecurity for enterprises and hyperscalers, mostly in the US. Part of Essar. Watch data-centre demand and margins.

companies.name: Brigade Enterprises

parts.SELLS: Brigade Enterprises develops homes, offices, shopping malls and hotels, mostly in south India. It builds apartments and villas in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad and Mysuru, runs office parks such as World Trade Center Bengaluru and Chennai, and Orion malls. Its hotel arm, Brigade Hotel Ventures, listed separately in July 2025.
parts.EARNS: Selling apartments is its largest revenue source, recognised as projects are completed. Leasing offices and malls brings steady rental income, and hotels like Sheraton Grand and Holiday Inn add hospitality revenue.
parts.SIZE: One of south India's leading real-estate developers and among the largest in Bengaluru, with a big mix of residential, commercial and hospitality assets built up since it was founded in 1986.
parts.RIVALS: Prestige Estates, Sobha, Godrej Properties, Puravankara and Embassy Group in Bengaluru and other south Indian cities, plus national developers expanding into the south.
parts.WATCH: New project launches in Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad, leasing of its office parks, its push into new cities, and how the separately listed hotel arm grows its portfolio.

quiz.prompt: Which Brigade business listed separately in July 2025?
options: Its hotel arm, Brigade Hotel Ventures

quiz.prompt: What is Brigade's largest revenue source?
Which developer competes with Brigade in Bengaluru?

companies.note_30w: Brigade Enterprises is a Bengaluru developer of homes, offices, Orion malls and hotels across south India. Watch launches, office leasing and its separately listed hotel arm.

companies.name: Brookfield India REIT

parts.SELLS: Brookfield India Real Estate Trust owns large office campuses in Mumbai, Gurugram, Noida, Kolkata and Bengaluru, including Candor TechSpace parks, Downtown Powai and Ecoworld in Bengaluru. Its tenants are mainly global technology, consulting and financial firms. It is sponsored by Canada's Brookfield.
parts.EARNS: It earns rent from office tenants on multi-year leases, plus maintenance and parking income. As a REIT, it pays out most of its cash flow to unitholders. Leasing to multinational tenants and global capability centres drives its income.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest office REITs and the only one fully sponsored by a global asset manager, with campuses spread across several of the country's biggest office markets.
parts.RIVALS: Embassy Office Parks REIT, Mindspace Business Parks REIT, Knowledge Realty Trust and Bagmane Prime Office REIT, plus private office landlords such as DLF and RMZ.
parts.WATCH: Leasing up vacant space, rent increases on renewals, integration of Ecoworld in Bengaluru, and further acquisitions from its sponsor that it announces.

quiz.prompt: Which global firm sponsors this REIT?
How does Brookfield India REIT mainly earn money?
Which is a rival office REIT?

companies.note_30w: Brookfield India REIT owns office campuses in Mumbai, Gurugram, Noida, Kolkata and Bengaluru leased to multinationals. Watch leasing, rent renewals and acquisitions from its sponsor.

companies.name: CCL Products

parts.SELLS: CCL Products makes instant coffee, mostly as a private-label supplier for coffee brands and retailers around the world, and also sells its own Continental Coffee brand in India. It has factories in Andhra Pradesh, Vietnam and Switzerland, and offers spray-dried, freeze-dried and agglomerated coffee.
parts.EARNS: Most of its revenue comes from exporting instant coffee in bulk or packed form to brand owners across Europe, Russia, the Middle East and Asia. It earns a processing margin, passing on coffee bean price changes to customers. The Indian retail brand is small but growing.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest private-label instant coffee makers and India's biggest instant coffee exporter, supplying brand owners in many countries from its plants in India and Vietnam.
parts.RIVALS: Nestle's Nescafe, Hindustan Unilever's Bru and Tata Consumer in India; global private-label coffee makers in Brazil and Vietnam compete with it for export customers.
parts.WATCH: Its expansion of freeze-dried capacity in Vietnam and India, growth of the Continental Coffee brand, and swings in global coffee bean prices, which affect working capital even when passed on.

quiz.prompt: What is CCL Products' own Indian coffee brand?
How does CCL mainly earn?
options: Exporting instant coffee for other brands

quiz.prompt: Which brand competes with CCL in India?

companies.note_30w: CCL Products is a Hyderabad-based private-label instant coffee giant exporting worldwide, with its own Continental Coffee brand in India. Watch Vietnam expansion and coffee bean prices.

companies.name: CESC

parts.SELLS: CESC, part of the RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group, generates and distributes electricity. It supplies power to homes and businesses in Kolkata and Howrah, and through subsidiaries in Greater Noida and distribution franchises in Rajasthan. It runs coal-fired plants in West Bengal and Maharashtra and is building renewable capacity through Purvah Green Power.
parts.EARNS: Its regulated distribution business in Kolkata, which owns its own power plants, is the core earner. Tariffs are set by state regulators, which allow a return on approved costs. Generation for other states and renewables add the rest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's oldest private power utilities, supplying electricity in Kolkata since the end of the nineteenth century, and one of the largest privately owned integrated utilities in the country.
parts.RIVALS: Tata Power, Adani Energy Solutions, Torrent Power and NTPC, especially in bids for new distribution licences and renewable projects, plus other renewable developers selling green power.
parts.WATCH: Its build-out of solar and wind capacity through Purvah, bids for state distribution businesses being privatised, and tariff orders from the West Bengal regulator.

quiz.prompt: Which group owns CESC?
What is CESC's core earner?
Which company is a CESC rival?

companies.note_30w: CESC, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group utility, supplies power to Kolkata and runs plants and franchises elsewhere. Watch renewable build-out via Purvah and new distribution bids.

companies.name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions

parts.SELLS: CG Power makes electrical equipment: industrial and railway motors, transformers, switchgear and traction systems for trains. It is part of the Murugappa Group, which rescued it in 2020. parts.RIVALS: Biocon in fermentation-based ingredients, plus global makers such as Teva and Chinese fermentation producers that compete on immunosuppressants and antibiotics.
parts.WATCH: Its new formulations and injectables capacity, approvals from US and European regulators for new products, and expansion into new fermentation molecules it has announced.

companies.note_30w: Concord Biotech makes fermentation-based drug ingredients, especially transplant immunosuppressants, for drug makers worldwide. Watch new formulations capacity and regulatory approvals for new products.

companies.name: Container Corporation of India (CONCOR)

parts.SELLS: CONCOR, a government company under the Ministry of Railways, moves shipping containers by rail between ports and inland cities. It runs a large network of inland container depots and container freight stations, and also offers warehousing, first and last-mile road transport and cold-chain services.
parts.EARNS: Export-import (EXIM) container movement between ports and inland depots brings in most revenue, while domestic container traffic is smaller but growing. It earns freight charges, terminal fees and handling and storage charges.
parts.SIZE: India's largest container rail operator by a wide margin, with the biggest network of inland container depots in the country and a dominant share of container trains running to major ports.
parts.RIVALS: Adani Logistics, Gateway Distriparks, Hind Terminals and other private container train operators, plus road trucking companies that compete for cargo on many shorter routes.
parts.WATCH: Ajit Kumar Panda took over as CMD in August 2026; watch growth of traffic on the dedicated freight corridors, land-licence fees paid to railways, and domestic container growth.

companies.note_30w: CONCOR is India's largest container rail operator, moving export-import and domestic boxes via inland depots. Watch new CMD Ajit Kumar Panda and freight-corridor traffic growth.

companies.name: Coromandel International

parts.SELLS: Coromandel International, part of the Murugappa Group, makes phosphatic and complex fertilisers sold under the Gromor brand, plus crop-protection chemicals, organic fertilisers and specialty nutrients. It runs Mana Gromor rural retail stores and took control of crop-protection maker NACL Industries in 2025.
parts.EARNS: Nutrient and allied products, mainly phosphatic fertilisers sold under a government subsidy system, bring in most revenue. Crop protection is smaller but earns higher margins, and it is growing through NACL and new products.
parts.SIZE: India's largest private-sector maker of phosphatic fertilisers and one of the country's leading agri-input companies, with especially strong reach in south India.
parts.RIVALS: Chambal Fertilisers, Paradeep Phosphates, Deepak Fertilisers and cooperative IFFCO in fertilisers; UPL, PI Industries and Dhanuka Agritech in crop protection.
parts.WATCH: Integration of NACL Industries, new fertiliser and phosphoric acid capacity it has announced, changes to the nutrient-based subsidy, and monsoon-driven farm demand.

companies.name: Craftsman Automation

parts.SELLS: Craftsman Automation makes precision-machined engine parts such as cylinder blocks and heads for trucks, tractors and construction equipment; aluminium die-cast parts for cars and two-wheelers; and industrial products like storage solutions and gearboxes. It expanded in aluminium castings by buying Sunbeam Lightweighting in 2024.
parts.EARNS: Its powertrain business, machining engine and transmission parts for commercial vehicles and tractors, has been its biggest profit driver. Aluminium products have grown into a major revenue segment after the Sunbeam acquisition.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading machining specialists for commercial-vehicle engine parts, and among the larger aluminium die-casting suppliers after its acquisitions.
parts.RIVALS: Endurance Technologies, Rico Auto, Sundram Fasteners, Bharat Forge and Sandhar Technologies in auto components, and Godrej Storage Solutions in industrial storage.
parts.WATCH: Integration of Sunbeam Lightweighting, new plants it has announced, commercial-vehicle and tractor demand, and supply to global customers for exports.
